gbm_population_evidence.quote: Confirmed MGMT promoter unmethylated glioblastoma multiforme. Patients with secondary glioblastoma, in particular those who are IDH1 or IDH2 mutant, will not be excluded. High grade gliomas with molecular features of glioblastoma will be included.

candidate_evidence.quote: This study will test the hypothesis that a personalized neoantigen DNA vaccine in combination with concurrent administration of immune checkpoint blockade therapy will enhance the magnitude and breadth of neoantigen-specific T cell responses while maintaining an acceptable safety profile.
Retifanlimab is given at a fixed dose of 500 mg every 28 days.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Neoantigen-based Personalized DNA Vaccine With Retifanlimab PD-1 Blockade Therapy in Patients With Newly Diagnosed, Unmethylated Glioblastoma

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Immunogenicity as measured by T-cell phenotype, myeloid derived suppressor cell frequency (MDSC) assessed by flow cytometry
Immunogenicity as measured by the number of subjects in a cohort who develop at least one demonstrable neoantigen CD8 T cell response by day 71 after administration of the first dose of vaccine

role_evidence.quote: Cohort A will receive the personalized neoantigen DNA vaccine via electroporation mediated IM injection alone during the first two priming doses

agents.drug_class_hint: personalised neoantigen DNA cancer vaccine delivered by IM electroporation
arms: Cohort A: Personalized neoantigen DNA vaccine + retifanlimab

role_evidence.quote: Cohort B will receive the personalized neoantigen DNA vaccine via electroporation mediated IM injection plus concurrent retifanlimab beginning with Dose 1 and continuing for a total of 6 doses.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Immune checkpoint blockade, specifically those targeting the PD-1/PD-L1 pathways, has shown efficacy in multiple solid and hematologic malignancies.

source_quote.quote: No candidate neoantigen identified during screening.

coder_notes: Retifanlimab is the only investigational drug; the personalized neoantigen DNA vaccine is an excluded intervention type (as in the pembrolizumab + vaccine worked example), and the electroporation device is not an agent. Cohorts A and B differ only in timing of retifanlimab; neither is a control. IDH: step 1 requires IDH-wildtype but step 2 states IDH-mutant secondary GBM will not be excluded (internal inconsistency); cns5 coded per the both-criteria rule. Neoantigen requirement is an exclusion criterion (no candidate neoantigen), not matched because the vaccine is not a candidate. Target engagement coded yes for immune-monitoring endpoints (T-cell responses, T-cell phenotype/MDSC) that reflect the vaccine plus PD-1 blockade; these are primarily vaccine immunogenicity measures.
